seo_title: The Wordless Hour: Language, Limiting Beliefs, and What a Sound Bath Interrupts | Sound Bath Calendar
title: The wordless hour
meta_description: My ex-wife used to introduce me as someone who was great at making money. We have been divorced for years and I still say it to myself most afternoons. An essay on the kind words other people hand you, why you keep repeating them long after they leave, and what an hour of gongs does that a conversation cannot.
